name: Skillet Gnocchi With Miso Butter and Asparagus
desc: Ali Slagle's one-skillet gnocchi, seared not boiled, glossed in miso butter

ingredients.raw: 18 ounces shelf-stable potato gnocchi (do not boil)
1 pound asparagus, trimmed, cut into 1-inch pieces

steps: Sear the gnocchi: Heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in a large nonstick or well-seasoned cast iron skillet over medium-high. Break apart any stuck-together gnocchi and add 18 ounces shelf-stable potato gnocchi (do not boil) in an even layer. Cover and cook undisturbed until golden brown underneath and releasing from the pan, 2 to 4 minutes .

Make miso butter: While gnocchi sears, smash together 4 tablespoons unsalted butter, room temp, 2 tablespoons white miso, 2 teaspoons rice vinegar, and 1/4 teaspoon black pepper, freshly ground in a small bowl until fully combined.

Cook the asparagus: Add 1 pound asparagus, trimmed, cut into 1-inch pieces and 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until bright green and crisp-tender, 2 to 3 minutes .

Finish with miso butter and arugula: Turn off the heat and add the miso butter in spoonfuls. Stir until melted and the gnocchi are glossed in sauce. Season with salt and pepper, then stir in 2 cups baby arugula, packed until just wilted. Serve immediately.
